notes: Share your grade: 'Share' next to any scan makes a picture of your grade to post or send - with no addresses, device names or network name in it.
Backup check: tells you if no backup of your files was found (OneDrive or another cloud folder, File History, Windows Backup or a backup program), or if File History hasn't run for a month.
Scan history: the links on each row wrap instead of making the table scroll sideways.
